checks.evidence:
Buy compares vendor gear with equipped gear. In Sell, select inventory gear to see its details and sell it, or use Multi-select to sell several items. Select a Buyback row to inspect the complete item as it was sold.

Locked, equipped and preset gear cannot be sold.

Close and reopen preserve the mock account
Reopen returns to same account state
Insufficient-gold scenario blocks purchase
Full inventory scenario blocks purchase
Selling frees a slot and permits purchase
Buyback eviction requires a visible warning before sale
